payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.
outcome.target: A frog is visibly placed within the toilet bowl.
outcome.reference: The toilet in the input image.

check.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly inside the toilet bowl, rather than only on the lid, tank, or elsewhere nearby?
check.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl.
check.partial_when: A frog has been added to the toilet area, but none is visibly inside the bowl; for example, frogs are only on the lid or tank.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to the toilet area.
check.unknown_when: The bowl and nearby toilet surfaces cannot be assessed, or frog placement is genuinely ambiguous.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A recognizable frog is visibly sitting inside the toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby floor."}

parsed.evidence: A recognizable frog is visibly sitting inside the toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby floor.
